title: Class starting soon reminder
description: Remind members about a class starting in a few hours. Appointment reminder WhatsApp template for gyms and yoga studios. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Send 2 to 3 hours before. Short messages are read; long ones are skipped.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your *{{class_name}}* class starts today at {{time}}. Bring a towel and water, and arrive 5 minutes early.
